verses.1: When Israel went forth out of Egypt, The house of Jacob from a people of strange language;
verses.2: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.
verses.3: The sea saw it, and fled; The Jordan was driven back.
verses.4: The mountains skipped like rams, The little hills like lambs.
verses.5: What aileth thee, O thou sea, that thou fleest? Thou Jordan, that thou turnest back?
verses.6: Ye mountains, that ye skip like rams; Ye little hills, like lambs?
verses.7: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, At the presence of the God of Jacob,
verses.8: Who turned the rock into a pool of water, The flint into a fountain of waters.
